subject: [PATCH v4] mm: bypass swap readahead for zswap

2026-11-02.patch_summary: This patch bypasses swap readahead for zswap, an in-memory, synchronous backend similar to zram. The current implementation of swap readahead is optimized for disk-based swaps and can cause unnecessary page cache thrashing and compression traffic when used with in-memory swaps like zswap. By bypassing readahead for zswap, the patch aims to reduce memory usage, improve performance, and decrease compression overhead. The results show significant gains in build time, reduced swap-in and -out rates, and a substantial reduction in swap readahead pages. The patch is based on measurements from various systems and configurations.
